manual_review_notes: Printed attack Bind Down deals 10 damage and prevents retreat during the opponent's next turn.
Ability Agile removes Retreat Cost when no Energy is attached. Printed attack Live Coal deals 20 damage.
Printed attack Fire Claws deals 30 damage.
Ascension searches for an Evolution card. Quick Attack deals 20 damage plus 20 more on a successful coin flip.
Colorful Catch searches for up to three Basic Energy cards of different types. Headbutt deals 20 damage.
Ability Rainbow DNA permits evolution into Pokémon ex that evolve from Eevee. Coruscating Quartz deals 200 damage.
Ability Boosted Evolution allows first-turn evolution while Active. Reckless Charge deals 30 damage and 10 self-damage.
Ability Last-Ditch Catch searches for a Supporter when played from hand onto the Bench. Tuck Tail deals 60 damage and returns Meowth ex and attached cards to the hand.
